justification: The only shared content is the presence of human figures: A is a single three-dimensional bust-like figure with a modelled face, prominent eye and nose and a torso, while B shows a flat scattered composition of tiny silhouette stick-figures with weapons, a large antlered quadruped and several crewed boats. Nothing links them beyond the universal depiction of a human being; the conventions (volumetric individualised head versus schematic filled silhouettes in a multi-figure narrative scene) are entirely different.
